scope: Independent read-only inspection of every actual PNG using view_image; aggregate/report spot checks only. No regeneration, model, numerical library, prediction-array, training, or inference run.

acceptance.meaning: Two figures need numerical-axis layout correction before a clean visual acceptance. No scientific-value mismatch was found in the specified spot checks.

findings.observation: The five 4-decimal labels (approximately −0.0050,−0.0025,0.0000,0.0025,0.0050) have insufficient gaps and visually join. Other panel spacing is also tight, but NDCG is the concrete defect.
findings.impact: The numerical CI scale is difficult to read as separate tick values.
findings.bounded_fix: Use fewer major ticks or compact/scientific formatting, with a readable shared scale multiplier if used. Reopen the regenerated PNG at native size and normal fit width; require separated glyph bounds.

findings.location: Top-left contribution panel X ticks; top-right X ticks also crowded
findings.observation: Top-left 5-decimal tick labels from0 to≈0.002 are rendered as a near-continuous string. Top-right signed four-decimal labels also touch or nearly touch.
findings.impact: Exact contribution magnitudes cannot be reliably read from the numerical axis despite readable raw-ID/title labels and bars.
findings.bounded_fix: Reduce major tick count and/or use scientific formatting. Verify all four panels, including lower-right five-decimal scale, after regeneration.

findings.location: Right panel lower-left legend and teal step0→250 segment
findings.observation: The diagonal Δunsupported line passes through the legend samples/text.
findings.impact: Legend and data compete locally; endpoints, threshold and feasibility result remain interpretable.
findings.bounded_fix: Move legend to empty space or outside axes, or give it an opaque frame. Reopen the actual PNG to ensure it clears all curves.

limits: Visual inspection and compact saved-aggregate cross-checks do not establish independent scientific validity or counterfactual accuracy.
No raw interaction/feature/model/prediction arrays were opened and no numeric replay was attempted.
